description: Several layers: the first is on top, and positions are percentages of the free space.

florui.css: .box { width: 120px; height: 80px; background-color: #1b1b2f; background-image: linear-gradient(#ffd166, #ffd166), linear-gradient(to right, #ff5a5f, #3a86ff); background-size: 30px 30px, 100% 50%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-position: 100% 100%, 0 0; }

classification.reason: Chromium dithers gradients, so a smooth gradient differs from this engine by one level of 255 on a third of its pixels (max error 1, mean about 0.3); channel_tolerance 2 stops that from counting. Measured against desktop Chrome: nothing differs by more than 2 levels, geometry an exact match.
